regressionsReproduced.before: Locking during a move disabled automation.
regressionsReproduced.after: Automation stays enabled; expected cancellation has no movement error.

regressionsReproduced.before: Display changes discarded pending routing when automatic layout restoration was disabled.
regressionsReproduced.after: Open windows are queued again after displays settle.

regressionsReproduced.before: An accepted move/focus request was treated as success even when the window remained invisible.
regressionsReproduced.after: The operation checks actual visibility and focus on the active destination and reports failure while preserving Return home.

regressionsReproduced.before: Finder had no NSRunningApplication.launchDate on the test Mac. Summon aborted before any move with an app-or-display identification error despite granted window access.
regressionsReproduced.after: Process identity preserves the LaunchServices timestamp when available and falls back to the kernel process start time otherwise. Missing process identity and unavailable displays have separate errors.

guiCheck.result: The running 0.3.3 app had window access and reported an app-or-display identification failure. A read-only process probe confirmed Finder had no LaunchServices launch date. The compiled 0.3.4 native code supplied a stable kernel start time for the same running Finder, retained the LaunchServices date for System Settings, and matched the existing saved return record.
guiCheck.scope: The process identity failure is reproduced and the corrected native lookup is verified against running processes. The 0.3.4 bundle has been built and packaged; GUI summon and return are not yet verified.
guiCheck.blocker: Native UI inspection failed with a closed pipe. No alternate UI-control mechanism was used.

iconVerification.packaging: Tools/BuildIcon.swift validates and packages ten PNG representations into a standard ICNS container.

notYetVerified: Live click and number-key actions in the nonactivating 0.3.4 picker
Live summon, visibility/focus verification and return in the packaged version
The specific cause of missing windows in the user screenshot; per-app discovery counters were added to identify it
Chrome profile recognition and automatic routing after upgrading
resourceBehavior: Routing is event-based. Pointer focus uses mouse-move events and one pending dwell check, with no repeating idle timer or screenshots. Mission Control name overlays are not started and their polling is disabled. These implementation properties are not a CPU/RAM benchmark.
namingScope: Labels in the DeskPilot panel and menu only. Mission Control naming and transparency experiments are deferred; Apple labels remain unchanged.
codeSigning: Ad hoc development signature; no valid code-signing identity was available. Rebuilding can invalidate macOS privacy grants. DESKPILOT_SIGNING_IDENTITY accepts an existing stable identity. No privacy settings, certificates or SIP configuration were changed.

chromeCatalogChecks.bookmarkTestContext: Synthetic files in a restricted test process. Minimal bookmarks passed; the sandbox rejected security-scope issuance, so the system file picker grant still needs GUI verification.

summonAndReturn.environment: Actual engine with synthetic windows and an injected desktop service
summonAndReturn.persistence: Per-window original Space, relative frame, minimized state, app identity and process start time are written before movement. No titles are added to temporary-return records.
summonAndReturn.liveVerification: Process identity verified against running Finder and System Settings; actual GUI summon and return pending for 0.3.4.

historicalLiveEvidence.result: The user confirmed profile recognition in 0.2.3; its runtime reported a readable catalog with two profiles and later two recognized native Chrome windows out of three. This does not establish recognition of every window or post-upgrade permission.

User confirmed moving one recognized Chrome profile to an existing desktop; its assignment was subsequently present in the application settings. The engine only saves that assignment after checking the native destination.

In 0.2.4, the packaged GUI reported WindowManager, desktop count increased from six to seven, assignment count increased from five to six, and the completed operation reported Done without an error. The user then reported that subsequent windows were not routed; this does not establish end-to-end automatic routing.

limitations: Simulated checks do not establish live macOS movement, focus or granted permissions.
Automatic side-by-side placement applies to exactly two recognized non-minimized windows from different groups after an authorized move. Additional windows keep their positions.
Returning a summoned window restores its recorded geometry; the resident window retains its current size.
Dragging a single window does not authorize a new permanent home. Use Share desktop, Move to or summon for intentional grouping.
Space management relies on private functions and Accessibility; macOS updates require compatibility checks.

shortcutChange.validation: Control-Space remains registered. The picker now uses a nonactivating panel, first-click acceptance and visible action feedback.
shortcutChange.liveVerification: Pending; a system-wide registration conflict remains possible and is reported by the app.

pickerImplementation.activation: NSPanel with nonactivatingPanel and canJoinAllSpaces; opening it does not call NSApp.activate.
pickerImplementation.feedback: The first click is accepted; operations show progress and remain open on failure. Success closes only the originating picker session.
pickerImplementation.hover: Pointer focus is suspended while the picker is open.

processIdentity.primary: NSRunningApplication.launchDate; preserved for compatibility with previously saved return records.
processIdentity.fallback: proc_pidinfo with PROC_PIDTBSDINFO, including start-time microseconds; rejects invalid PIDs, incomplete responses and invalid timestamps.
processIdentity.verification: The native regression fixture has no LaunchServices date. The real Finder also lacked it and received the expected stable kernel date. Existing System Settings return data remained valid.
processIdentity.scope: Read-only metadata lookup. No additional privacy grant, background timer or SIP change.
